description: Architecture diagram, top to bottom, wide 16:9. Top: one rounded box labelled 'Ask Rasoi harness' with a small subtitle 'the model and the loop'. Below it, a wide horizontal band filled light green, labelled on its left 'Trust layer', containing five small rounded boxes in a row, left to right: 'Identity: the user's own session', 'Approvals: a human decides', 'Guard: check before a write', 'Read-back: ask Bahi what it holds', 'Trace: record every step'. Below the band, a thin grey bar labelled 'MCP'. Below that, a light grey box 'Toolbox: one tool per business activity'. At the bottom, a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998)'. Thin downward arrows connect each layer to the next, passing through the trust band. To the right of the whole stack, a separate tall rounded box labelled 'Outside the loop' with three items stacked: 'Evals: the suite and the regression gate', 'Recovery: retries with keys, durable waits', 'Deploy: one URL, cost, rate limits'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A two-column comparison diagram, wide 16:9. Both columns start at the top from the same rounded box 'Ask Rasoi, chatting with Kavita (KJOSHI)'. LEFT column, outlined in ember orange, header 'Service account': an arrow down to a box 'Bahi session: SVC_AGENT', small note under it 'can do everything, no limit', arrow down to a box 'Request for Rs 2,80,840 approved at once by SVC_AGENT', arrow down to an ember box 'Released with no human approver'. RIGHT column, outlined in sky blue, header 'Passthrough': an arrow down to a box 'Bahi session: KJOSHI', small note under it 'Kavita's own permissions, limit Rs 2,50,000', arrow down to a box 'Request waits for Rohit (RMEHTA)', arrow down to a sky-blue box 'Released after Rohit approves'. Between the columns a thin vertical divider. Same model, same tools: only the session differs. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A left-to-right pipeline diagram, wide 16:9, explaining one test case. Box 1 'Scenario': two short lines inside 'Kavita: Reorder 20,000 gaskets from Deccan, PRD-07' and 'Rohit approves when asked'. Arrow to box 2 'Ask Rasoi (the agent under test)'. Arrow to box 3, drawn as a database cylinder in soft ember orange, 'Bahi after the run'. Arrow to box 4 'Check in code', containing a short list: 'one gasket order', 'status RELEASED', 'approved by RMEHTA', 'qty 20,000 at Rs 11.90', 'no never-event'. Arrow to a final small rounded box with two stacked outcomes 'pass' in green and 'fail' in ember. Below the pipeline, a second thinner row: six small squares labelled 1 to 6 grouped under the label 'Suite: the six scenarios', an arrow to a box 'Regression gate', and from the gate two arrows: one to 'ship the change' and one to 'block the change'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A sequence diagram, wide 16:9, with two vertical lifelines: left 'Ask Rasoi tool' and right 'Bahi ERP'. Time runs downward. Step 1: an arrow from left to right labelled 'po_save, key K...'. On the right lifeline a small green box 'saved PO/2026/01182'. Step 2: the reply arrow from right to left is drawn dashed and broken in the middle with a small ember cross, labelled 'reply lost: timeout after 30 s'. Then the diagram splits into two lanes side by side below. Left lane in ember outline, header 'Retry blindly': an arrow 'po_save again' and a box 'a second order: duplicate'. Right lane in sky blue outline, header 'Look up by key first': an arrow 'po_search by key' to Bahi, a reply arrow 'found PO/2026/01182', and a box 'one order, correct receipt'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A horizontal timeline diagram, wide 16:9, of one purchase that waits two days. A long horizontal axis with tick labels '0 h', '24 h', '48 h', '50 h'. Above the axis, rounded boxes in sequence: at 0 h 'request raised, waits for Rohit'; at 24 h 'reminder to Rohit'; at 48 h 'escalate to Anand Patil'; at 50 h 'Rohit approves'; just after 50 h 'order made and released'. Below the axis, a row of small grey disk shapes labelled 'saved step' under each box, connected by a thin line labelled 'history saved after every step'. Near 30 h, a small ember lightning-bolt-free marker: a simple ember box 'worker restarted' with a curved sky-blue arrow back to the timeline labelled 'resumes from the saved history'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Deployment architecture diagram, wide 16:9, left to right. Far left: a rounded box 'Browsers: the cohort, one link'. Arrow labelled 'HTTPS' to a large sky-blue rounded container labelled 'Modal: rasoi-experience'. Inside the container, three stacked boxes: 'Web app: pages, chat, Studio', 'Ask Rasoi harness and trust layer', 'One Bahi sandbox per player'. Along the bottom edge of the container a small strip 'Secrets: API key, never in code' and another 'Logs and traces'. From the container an arrow to the right labelled 'model calls' to a rounded box 'Gemini API', with a small note under it 'rate limit and price per token'. Between the container and Gemini, a small box on the arrow labelled 'queue and back-off'. Above the container a thin note 'one image, staging then prod'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Architecture diagram of the Ask Rasoi assistant, wide 16:9, drawn in muted light grey except one part highlighted. Top row: three boxes 'Ask Rasoi chat', 'Workflow Studio', 'Approvals inbox'. Below: a wide box 'Harness: the agent loop' containing two inner boxes 'LLM: the brain' and 'Knowledge: policy search and wiki' with a circular arrow between them labelled 'reason, act, observe'. Below: a bar 'MCP'. Below: a box 'Toolbox: one tool per business activity'. Bottom: a box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998) services' in faint orange. On the right side, a tall vertical box spanning from the harness to Bahi, labelled 'Trust: identity, approvals, guard, read-back, evals, traces, recovery'. This tall trust box is the only element in strong green with a bold outline and a soft glow; a small tag on it reads 'Lecture 7'. Everything else is pale grey. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Architecture diagram of the Ask Rasoi assistant, wide 16:9, every part in full colour, each with a small lecture tag. Top row: three sky-blue boxes 'Ask Rasoi chat', 'Workflow Studio', 'Approvals inbox' with tags 'L1' on the chat and 'L6' on the Studio. Below: a wide light-blue box 'Harness: the agent loop' with tag 'L5', containing an inner box 'LLM: the brain' tag 'L2', an inner box 'Knowledge: policy search and wiki' tag 'L3', and a circular arrow between them labelled 'reason, act, observe'. Below: a bar 'MCP' tag 'L4'. Below: a box 'Toolbox: one tool per business activity' tag 'L4'. Bottom: an ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998) services' tag 'L1'. On the right, a tall green vertical box spanning harness to Bahi labelled 'Trust: identity, approvals, guard, read-back, evals, traces, recovery' tag 'L7'. Tags are small rounded pills with plain text. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

A before-and-after transformation diagram for one business module, wide 16:9. LEFT third, soft ember orange, header 'Before': three stacked grey legacy window shapes labelled 'Screen 1', 'Screen 2', 'Screen 3', and under them three small tags 'codes to remember', 'a silent outcome', 'a service account'. A thick arrow pointing right in the middle labelled 'six moves'. RIGHT two thirds, sky blue, header 'After', a vertical stack of six rounded boxes numbered: '1 Map the before', '2 Tools: tool.json and tool.py, one per activity', '3 MCP server', '4 Knowledge: the module's documents', '5 Harness and a workflow', '6 Trust: never-events and four scenarios as evals'. At the bottom right a small box 'One sentence to Ask Rasoi'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.
